incidents.title: SF overdose deaths down 24% so far this year
incidents.summary: 351 deaths January to August 2026, against 460 a year earlier. Fentanyl still drives most deaths.

incidents.title: Four arrested after the cychlorphine death
incidents.summary: Officials announced four arrests of suspected dealers and said Narcan should still be used, though it works only within a short window.

incidents.title: DEA temporarily schedules cychlorphine and related orphines
incidents.molecules: cychlorphine (N-propionitrile chlorphine) and three other orphines
incidents.summary: Cychlorphine and three related orphine opioids go into Schedule I from Aug 27, 2026, on a temporary two-year order.

incidents.title: July 2026: SF's lowest monthly count since 2020
incidents.summary: 34 preliminary overdose deaths in July, the lowest monthly count since 2020.

incidents.title: Reno bust: about 236,000 potentially lethal fentanyl doses
incidents.summary: A multi-agency task force arrested a Stockton man after a months-long investigation.

incidents.title: 3.8 kg of fentanyl seized at an Oakland mixing operation
incidents.summary: Deputies described a sophisticated operation for mixing and packaging fentanyl in a backyard unit.

incidents.title: Ohio's crime lab found 'orphine' opioids 36 times
incidents.summary: Ohio's state crime lab found orphine-class opioids such as cychlorphine 36 times since October 2025; 6 of 8 seized items tested through January were tied to overdoses.

incidents.title: US overdose deaths fell again in 2025
incidents.summary: About 70,000 deaths in 2025, down 14% from 2024 and the third straight year of decline. Researchers credit naloxone, treatment, settlement money and a changed supply.

incidents.title: Nevada to receive $57.9M from the Purdue/Sackler settlement
incidents.summary: The money goes to the Fund for a Resilient Nevada; the state has secured over $1.2 billion in opioid settlements.

incidents.title: At least 55 US deaths linked to cychlorphine
incidents.summary: White House drug policy office: most common in Ohio, Texas and Tennessee across 2025 and 2026.
incidents.source: White House ONDCP drug threat notice

incidents.title: East Tennessee: 41 deaths tied to cychlorphine
incidents.summary: The Knox County Regional Forensic Center counted 41 overdose deaths involving cychlorphine across 11 East Tennessee counties, July 2025 to February 2026.

incidents.title: Teen dies after a counterfeit pill; autopsy finds three drugs
incidents.summary: A 16-year-old died in Nob Hill after taking a counterfeit pill, though his mother gave Narcan twice. Toxicology found cychlorphine, a nitazene and ethylbromazolam: SF's first known cychlorphine death.

incidents.title: CDC health advisory on medetomidine
incidents.summary: Medetomidine is spreading in the illegal opioid supply, highest in the Northeast, with a severe withdrawal syndrome. Give naloxone to any suspected overdose; suspect medetomidine when sedation persists.

incidents.title: California: 5 deaths with medetomidine in 2025
incidents.summary: CDPH brief: all five deaths also involved fentanyl. Small amounts found in SF, San Diego, the Inland Empire and LA. Likely an undercount, since testing is limited.

incidents.title: Cychlorphine found in counterfeit oxycodone pills
incidents.summary: The DEA detected cychlorphine in two counterfeit oxycodone pills in Northern California the same month as the SF death.

incidents.title: New synthetic opioid linked to Midwest overdoses
incidents.summary: Public-radio reporting on cychlorphine in the Midwest: it may not show on fentanyl test strips, and naloxone works but may take more than one dose.

incidents.title: DEA emergency-schedules bromazolam
incidents.summary: The designer benzodiazepine goes into Schedule I. DEA toxicology found fentanyl with it in 202 of 259 cases, so give naloxone anyway; it does not reverse the benzo itself.

incidents.title: LA County confirms its first cychlorphine death
incidents.summary: The medical examiner confirmed a February 2026 death as the county's first involving cychlorphine, its first sign in the local supply. Naloxone works, but more than one dose may be needed.

incidents.title: San Diego: 2 deaths involving nitazenes
incidents.summary: One in 2024 and one in 2025; not seen in recent drug-checking samples, though hard to detect at low doses.

incidents.title: SF: 4 deaths involving nitazenes since 2024
incidents.summary: Three in 2024 and one in 2025; nitazenes are rarely detected in the local supply.

incidents.title: Nitazene found in counterfeit M30 pills
incidents.summary: LA County's drug-checking program found isotonitazepyne in two counterfeit M30 pills.

incidents.title: Riverside County confirms first fatal carfentanil overdose
incidents.summary: A man in his 40s who died in March 2025; confirmation took months because the death happened outside the county.

incidents.title: Santa Clara County's first carfentanil death
incidents.summary: A 39-year-old man died of a carfentanil overdose and was found with counterfeit M30 pills. Carfentanil is about 100 times stronger than fentanyl.

incidents.title: First SF death involving medetomidine
incidents.summary: SF's health department confirmed the city's first death involving medetomidine, an animal sedative naloxone cannot reverse. Officials still advise giving naloxone.

incidents.title: Festival naloxone tour ends at Burning Man
incidents.summary: The nonprofit This Must Be The Place handed out donated nasal naloxone at festivals and planned to end its tour at Burning Man.
